resourceName: Puning MSW Incineration and Power Generation
description:
Puning MSW incineration and power generation project (hereafter referred to as the project) is located in Yunluo Town, Puning City, Guangdong province, China. The Project is invested, constructed and operated by Puning Guangye Yueneng Environmental Protection Energy Co., Ltd.. (hereafter referred to as the project owner).
With two 600t/d MSW combustion production lines, the project will treat 1,200 tons of MSW per day. The combustion system is composed of two 600t/d mechanical grate incinerators, matched with one set of 25MW steam turbine generator. The project will process 438,000 tons of MSW every year, and consume 90 tons of 0# light diesel as auxiliary fuel. The MSW combustion line will work over 8,000 hours every year, generating 153,300 MWh electricity, of which 122,640 MWh will be exported to the China Southern Power Grid (hereinafter referred to as CSPG). The remaining electricity will be used by the project itself and there will be no purchased electricity. 
By combusting MSW that would otherwise be disposed of at landfill, the proposed project activity avoids the emission of methane that would be generated under landfill condition. In the meanwhile, by utilizing the waste heat from the combustion of MSW, the boilers can produce steam to generate power to replace the electricity that would otherwise be generated by fossil- fuel fired power plants which are connected to the CSPG.The baseline scenario of this project is the same as the scenario prior to the implementation of the project, namely the landfill gas is vented directly and the equivalent power is supplied by the CSPG.
The project is expected to provide electricity of 122640 MWh annually into CSPG. The total emission reduction is expected to be 940030 tons of CO2 and the average annual 
emission reduction is 134290 tons of CO2 in a period of 7 years (from 25 April 2022 to 25 April 2029).
